issue_request: FHIR-19969 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked for a technical correction because the Message Events example value set had zero members but was marked normative.
initial_application: Commit 0a3fa2810d, whose subject includes GF#19969, changed the old ValueSetGenerator so genMessageEvents used markSpecialStatus(vs, cs, false), correcting the generated normative metadata for the empty MessageEvents value set/code system while leaving other generated special value sets normative.
additional_context: The old generator is no longer present in the current source tree. Later final issues in the same family, especially FHIR-26902, removed active references to the empty core MessageEvent value set/code system and changed MessageHeader and MessageDefinition event bindings to descriptive example bindings. FHIR-32398 and duplicate FHIR-34080 support that later cleanup. MessageHeader and MessageDefinition are active build-scope resources in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current authoritative source has example/descriptive MessageEvent bindings without ValueSet/message-events, narrative says FHIR does not define MessageHeader event codes, and targeted active-source searches found no remaining core MessageEvent value set/code-system references.
